title: Event Management and State Persistence
summary: This module provides a robust event bus for managing synchronous and asynchronous events within CrewAI, along with mechanisms for event context tracking, state persistence, and memory analysis. It enables structured event emission, handling, and checkpointing for crew operations.

nodes.label: Define Base Event Structure
nodes.title: Base Event Definition
nodes.description: Establishes the fundamental structure and common attributes for all events in the system, serving as the base class for specific event types.

nodes.label: Manage Event Dispatch & Handlers
nodes.title: CrewAI Event Bus
nodes.description: A singleton event bus responsible for registering, emitting, and dispatching synchronous and asynchronous events to their respective handlers, managing their execution.

nodes.label: Manage Event Context Scope
nodes.title: Event Context Manager
nodes.description: Provides a context manager to establish and manage the parent-child hierarchy and scope of events, ensuring proper event lineage tracking during execution.

nodes.label: Confirm Tracing on First Run
nodes.title: Tracing Confirmation Utility
nodes.description: Prompts the user to enable tracing features during the first execution of CrewAI, integrating with CLI tools to configure event listeners for debugging.

nodes.label: A2A Push Notification Received
nodes.title: A2A Push Received Event
nodes.description: Represents an event triggered when a push notification is successfully received from a remote A2A agent, indicating a status update or message.

nodes.label: A2A Push Notification Sent
nodes.title: A2A Push Sent Event
nodes.description: Represents an event triggered when a push notification is sent by the A2A server to a client's registered callback URL, reporting task status.

nodes.label: A2A Agent Card Fetched
nodes.title: A2A Agent Card Fetched Event
nodes.description: Represents an event triggered when an A2A agent's metadata (agent card) is successfully retrieved, providing details about the agent's capabilities.

nodes.label: A2A Parallel Delegation Started
nodes.title: A2A Parallel Delegation Start Event
nodes.description: Indicates the beginning of a parallel delegation process where a task is distributed to multiple A2A agents concurrently for execution.

nodes.label: A2A Parallel Delegation Completed
nodes.title: A2A Parallel Delegation Complete Event
nodes.description: Indicates the completion of a parallel delegation process to multiple A2A agents, summarizing the outcomes, including success and failure counts.

nodes.label: A2A Context Created
nodes.title: A2A Context Created Event
nodes.description: Signals the creation of a new A2A context, which serves to group related tasks or conversations, providing a logical boundary for interactions.

nodes.label: A2A Context Expired
nodes.title: A2A Context Expired Event
nodes.description: Signals that an A2A context has expired due to its configured Time-To-Live (TTL) setting, leading to its automatic removal from active state.

nodes.label: A2A Context Became Idle
nodes.title: A2A Context Idle Event
nodes.description: Signals that an A2A context has become idle, meaning no activity has occurred within it for a specified period, potentially triggering cleanup.

nodes.label: A2A Context Completed
nodes.title: A2A Context Completed Event
nodes.description: Signals that all tasks within an A2A context have been successfully completed, marking the end of the context's active lifecycle.

nodes.label: A2A Context Pruned
nodes.title: A2A Context Pruned Event
nodes.description: Signals that an A2A context has been pruned (deleted) from the system, removing its metadata and associated tasks, often due to expiration or completion.

nodes.label: Analyze Memory for Saving
nodes.title: Memory Save Analysis
nodes.description: Infers optimal scope, categories, importance, and extracts metadata for new memory content using an LLM, facilitating structured storage and retrieval.

nodes.label: Analyze Memory for Consolidation
nodes.title: Memory Consolidation Analysis
nodes.description: Determines appropriate actions (insert, update, delete) for new memory content by comparing it against existing semantically similar records using an LLM.

nodes.label: Coerce Checkpoint Configuration
nodes.title: Checkpoint Config Coercion
nodes.description: Transforms raw input (e.g., boolean `True`) into a structured CheckpointConfig object and ensures necessary checkpoint handlers are registered.

nodes.label: Handle Events for Checkpointing
nodes.title: Checkpoint Event Listener
nodes.description: A universal event listener that monitors all events and triggers automatic checkpointing based on predefined configurations and event types.

nodes.label: Manage Event Execution Record
nodes.title: Event Record Management
nodes.description: Stores and manages a directed graph of execution events, automatically wiring relationships like parent-child and triggered-by, enabling historical analysis.

nodes.label: Resolve Event Type
nodes.title: Event Type Resolver
nodes.description: Validates and dynamically resolves raw event data (e.g., from a dictionary) into the correct specific BaseEvent subclass for accurate processing.

nodes.label: LLM
nodes.title: External LLM Service
nodes.description: An external Large Language Model service used for complex natural language understanding and generation tasks, such as memory analysis.

nodes.label: CLI
nodes.title: Command Line Interface
nodes.description: The Command Line Interface, serving as the primary user interaction point for configuring and managing system features like tracing.

groups.label: Event Core System
groups.title: Core Event Management
groups.description: Components forming the foundation of the event handling and recording system, including the event bus, base event structure, and event context management.

groups.label: A2A Notification & Delegation Events
groups.title: Agent-to-Agent Communication Events
groups.description: Specific event types related to Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, including push notifications, agent card fetching, and parallel delegation processes.

groups.label: A2A Context Lifecycle Events
groups.title: A2A Context Management Events
groups.description: Event types that signal various stages in the lifecycle of an A2A context, such as creation, expiration, idleness, completion, and pruning.

groups.label: State & Checkpointing
groups.title: State Persistence and Checkpointing
groups.description: Components responsible for managing the system's state persistence, including checkpoint configuration and event-driven checkpointing logic.

groups.label: Memory Analysis
groups.title: Memory Content Analysis
groups.description: Functions that leverage LLMs to analyze memory content for optimal storage (saving) and efficient management (consolidation) against existing records.

groups.label: Tracing Utilities
groups.title: Tracing Configuration
groups.description: Utility for configuring tracing features, typically involving user interaction via the command line interface during initial setup.
